expected_rate: once per symbol on each PT day a QHM hold is closed by its own stop; zero on days with no QHM stop exit
reversal: a fill that is not QHM's own recorded stop exit is excluded from the kill measure (a Day or Swing loss hidden from the 7% check), or a day with a QHM stop exit still logs protected_fill_on_ledger_flat_symbol for that same order

metrics.name: excluded_fill_matches_qhm_record
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log 'QHM own exit excluded' lines vs data/state/quarterly_holds.json exit_order_id/exit_qty and the Alpaca order
metrics.bound: every excluded fill's order id and qty equal the CLOSED hold's recorded exit

metrics.name: flat_symbol_unresolved_after_qhm_stop
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log 'protected_fill_on_ledger_flat_symbol' on a symbol whose QHM hold closed by its own stop that day
metrics.bound: 0 for holds closed after this deploy
